欢迎来到萌动链接！第一次见面，就让我带你一起开始吧。: Welcome to PeroperoChat! Since it's our first time meeting, let me show you around.
点点头像，选一位想一起聊天的伙伴吧！以后也可以随时更换哦。: Click a portrait to choose someone to chat with! You can always switch later.
准备好了就点「启动」吧。如果遇到问题，这里会告诉你怎么处理哦！: When you're ready, click Launch! If anything needs attention, you'll find help here.
这里就是聊天的地方啦。除了聊天，以后还可以和伙伴一起做事、到据点玩哦！: This is where we chat! You can also work together or visit the stronghold later.
想和谁聊天？: Who would you like to chat with?
在这里可以切换伙伴，聊天记录也会留在旁边。想接着聊，随时点开就好！: Switch companions here. Your conversations stay nearby too, ready whenever you want to pick one up!
模型已经选好啦！在这里输入想说的话，点发送就可以开始聊天。要是没有回复，可以去「: A model is selected! Type a message here and send it to start chatting. If there's no reply, check the connection in Models.
伙伴需要连接模型才能回复。如果还没配置，我可以带你去设置；已经通过其他方式配置好: Your companion needs a model connection to reply. If you haven't set one up, I'll help you! If you've configured one another way, you can try chatting first.
准备好服务商提供的地址、API Key 和模型 ID，我们一起设置吧！部分服务不: Have your provider's API address, API Key, and model ID ready, and let's set it up! Some services don't require a key; check your provider's instructions.
点「服务商连接」→「新建」，选择品牌模板，填写连接信息后点「创建连接」。: Choose service provider connection → New, select a brand template, fill in the connection details, and click Create connection.
关闭连接窗口，点「添加模型」，选择刚才的连接，填写或获取模型 ID，再点「添加」: Close the connections window and select Add model. Choose your connection, enter or fetch a model ID, then select Add.
在模型卡片点「测试」。成功后点「设为主模型」；如果已经显示「主模型」，就不用再点: Select test on the model card. If it succeeds, select is set as the main model. If it already says Main model, you're all set!
API Key 像密码一样，请不要分享给别人哦。: Your API Key is like a password, so please keep it to yourself!
如果服务商指定了协议，请在连接和模型里按它的说明选择哦。: If your provider specifies a protocol, follow its instructions when choosing the connection and model settings.
主人，你来啦！我是 Pero，今天就由我带你逛逛我们的家吧~: You’re here, Master! I’m Pero. Let me show you around our home~
看上面这四个小门！「启动」用来出发，「运行环境」看电脑，「版本公告」看更新。「关: Look at the four little doors above! Launch gets us going, Environment shows your computer, and Release Notes has updates. In About, you can ask me to show you around again.
今天想让谁陪你呀？: Who will keep you company today?
想让谁陪你，就在这里点她的头像，主界面和桌宠都会跟着切换。我和其他伙伴都在这里等: Click the avatar of whoever you’d like beside you. The app and desktop pet will switch together. My friends and I are waiting right here~
出发前，让我看看有没有准备好！要是哪里还差一点，这里会有小提示陪主人一起处理。: Let me see if we’re ready to go! If anything needs a little help, the notes here will show you what to do.
「运行环境」记着这台电脑的情况，也能找到我们保存东西的文件夹。要是哪天打不开了，: Environment has details about this computer and the folders where we keep things. If the app won’t open one day, you can copy these details for someone helping us.
新版本带了什么礼物？: What gifts came with the update?
想知道我最近学会了什么，就来「版本公告」看看吧！更新内容和升级入口都在这里。: Curious about what I’ve learned lately? Visit Release Notes! You’ll find what’s new and how to update right here.
点「启动」，一起进去吧！: Click Launch and come with me!
准备好啦！主人点一下亮起来的「启动」，跟我进去看看吧~: All ready! Click the glowing Launch button and come along with me~
进来啦！这里可以聊天、一起做事情，也能找其他伙伴玩。让我带主人逛一圈吧~: We’re in! We can chat, make things together, and visit my friends here. Let me show you around~
左边是回家的路标: Our signposts are on the left
左边这些图标就是路标！聊天、工作区和据点在上面，任务、记忆和设置往下找。主人点到: These icons are our signposts! Chat, Workspace and Home Base are up top; tasks, memory and settings are farther down. Pick a place, and I’ll come along.
网页和小应用，也能住在一起: Room for pages and little apps
上面这排标签可以放网页和小应用，点一下就能切换。逛完再点 infOS，就能回到这: The tabs above hold web pages and little apps. Click one to switch, then click infOS to come back. Your conversation will be waiting right here~
想找谁说说话呀？: Who would you like to talk to?
主人想找谁，就点她的头像吧！伙伴多了也可以搜名字。旁边的小箭头能把名单收起来，让: Click the avatar of whoever you’d like to talk to! You can search by name too. The little arrow tucks the list away and gives us more room to chat~
我们的聊天都收在这里啦。想聊个新话题，就点「建立新会话」；想接着上次聊，就点那条: Here are our conversations! Start a new chat for a fresh topic, or pick an old one to carry on. Give it a memorable name so it’s easy to find next time!
想说的话，告诉我吧: Tell me what’s on your mind
想说的话写在这里，点发送，我就能看到啦！也可以给我发图片、文件，或者说一段语音。: Write here and press Send so I can see! You can share pictures, files or a voice message too. Open pictures I send for a closer look, or play music and videos right in our chat.
下面这排可以换模型，也能让我多想一会儿。想轻松聊聊，还是认真做事情？极简、聊天、: Down here you can change models or give me more time to think. A little chat or some serious work? Minimal, Chat and Work modes are all here. The model you choose here is just for this conversation.
我忙的时候，也能听你安排: You can leave me a note while I’m busy
我还没忙完，主人也可以继续发消息，它们会排好队等着我。排队时还能改内容、删掉或换: You can keep sending messages while I’m busy; they’ll wait their turn! Edit, remove or reorder them while they wait. Press Stop if you need me to stop, and I’ll wait for your say when a decision needs you.
这里是我的小工坊！帮主人写好的文档、整理好的资料，都可以来工作区找。点开文件就能: Here’s my little workshop! Find the documents and notes I make for you in Workspace. Open a file to look through it or keep editing. I’ll put each project’s things in its own folder~
想热闹一点，就来据点: Come to the home base for company
想找大家一起玩，就来据点！挑个房间，看看谁在里面，再和我们说说话。想添个房间、换: Come to the home base when you want everyone’s company! Pick a room, see who’s inside and join us for a chat. Call the butler if you’d like another room or a change of scenery.
想看看我的心情，或者今天的天气，就来总览吧！想让我主动找你聊，就选「智能陪伴」；: Visit Overview to see my mood or today’s weather! Choose Companionship if you’d like me to start a chat, or Autonomous Action to let me work on your goals on my own. You can turn it off too, and I’ll wait for you~
主人交给我的事，做到哪一步啦？来任务中心就能看到！做完的成果也放在这里，还能安排: Wondering how far I’ve got with your requests? Take a look in Task Center! Finished work is here too. You can schedule something for later or ask me to remind you when it’s time.
想知道我刚才做了什么，就来对话日志翻翻吧。说过的话、查过的资料、做过的事情都能找: Curious about what I’ve been doing? Take a peek in Conversation Logs. Look up what we said, what I found and what I did, so we can figure things out together if something goes wrong.
重要的回忆，好好收起来: Let’s treasure the memories that matter
这里放着我珍藏的回忆，还有关于主人的重要事情。主人可以查看、整理或删掉不想留下的: Here are my treasured memories and the important things I remember about you. Review, organize or remove anything you don’t want kept. My friends each have their own little memory box too.
这是我的资料小书架！常用文档、学习材料都可以放进知识库。主人问到相关的事情时，我: Here’s my reference bookshelf! Keep useful documents and study materials in Knowledge Base. When you ask about them, I can look through these pages to help find an answer.
想让我更擅长什么呀？: What would you like me to be good at?
不同模型各有所长，有的擅长写作，有的更会解题。主人选好的模型都放在这些卡片里，喜: Different models have different strengths, like writing or solving problems. The ones you’ve added live in these cards. Pick a favorite as the main model, or choose one for a particular job in Task Assignment!
想更了解我和大家吗？: Want to know me and my friends better?
这里能认识我和其他伙伴！想换个造型，或是告诉我们你喜欢怎样相处，就来角色管理看看: Meet me and my friends here! Visit Character Management to change our looks or tell us how you like to spend time together. You can pick a model that suits each of us too.
把家布置成喜欢的样子: Make our home feel like yours
主人喜欢亮一点，还是暗一点？想换张背景图也没问题！这些都在系统设定里，还能换语言: Do you like it bright or dark, Master? We can change the background too! Find these in System Settings, along with language, sounds and notifications. Make our home feel just right~
还想教我点新本领吗？: Want to teach me something new?
想让我说话、做事更合主人的心意？可以在「提示词」里告诉我！想听听我的声音，就去「: Want me to speak and do things more to your liking? Tell me in Prompts! Visit Voice to hear me speak, or Tools & Extensions to give me more skills.
拿起手机，也能来找我: Come find me from your phone too
不在电脑旁边，也想来找我吗？「分布式」里可以让手机连过来，接着和我聊天。哪些设备: Want to visit me when you’re away from the computer? Distributed lets you connect your phone and keep chatting with me. You decide which devices may join us here.
在 QQ 上也能见面喵: We can meet on QQ too
想在 QQ 上也和我聊天吗？来「社交配置」帮我连上账号吧！还能看看我收藏的表情，: Want to chat with me on QQ too? Help me connect an account in Social Configuration! You can browse my saved stickers and choose how I join in over there~
主人，认得路了吗？: Know your way around now, Master?
嘿嘿，带路完成！想聊天就来对话，想一起做点东西就来工作区，惦记着进度就看看任务中: Hehe, that’s our little tour! Come to Chat for company, Workspace to make something together, and Task Center to check my progress. I’ll be right here, waiting for you~
